description: This file defines the class PdfReal, representing a real number in a PDF processing library. It inherits from PdfNumber and implements IConvertible, providing methods for conversions and string representations specific to PDF real values.

classes.name: PdfReal
classes.description: Represents a direct real number in a PDF document, encapsulating a double value and providing conversion and string formatting functionalities.

methods.name: PdfReal()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing a new instance of PdfReal with IsReal set to true.

methods.name: PdfReal(double value)
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new instance of PdfReal with a specified double value, asserting if the value is outside the range of a float.

methods.name: ToString()
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the Value, formatted with up to three significant decimal places using invariant culture.

methods.name: WriteObject(PdfWriter writer)
methods.description: Writes the real value to a PdfWriter, facilitating PDF serialization.

methods.name: GetTypeCode()
methods.description: Returns the system's TypeCode for the numeric type, specifically TypeCode.Double.
